name: Aircall

field_reviews.reason: Live developer.aircall.io authentication page (updated 2026-07-28): Basic Authentication with dashboard-generated API ID + token is the path for own-account integrations; no authorization flow needed.
Auth docs confirm exactly two methods: Basic Authentication (own tools) and OAuth (public integrations for multiple customers, restricted to approved tech partners).

Official aircall.io/pricing lists '250+ integrations and API access' on the self-serve Essentials plan ($30/user/mo annual, 3-license minimum). Nuance: direct Messaging API access requires the Professional plan and 'API developer support' is Custom-tier, but core REST API access is bundled with self-serve paid plans.
REST API at api.aircall.io/v1 covers calls, contacts, users, teams, numbers, messages, webhooks, and conversation-intelligence data.

REST-only public API; no vendor GraphQL/gRPC/MCP endpoint. Third-party MCP servers exist but are not an Aircall-operated protocol surface, so listing only rest is consistent with this batch's convention for platform/community MCPs (cf. Help Scout draft).

Both values are correct but the draft recorded no evidence URL. Found: Pipedream hosts a live Aircall MCP server page (platform MCP), and community servers exist — themobilefirstco/aircall-mcp-server (73 tools, README explicitly 'Unofficial') and CassiaResearch/aircall-mcp-server (83 tools, 'Not an official Aircall product'). No Aircall vendor MCP exists; even the community repo's comparison table lists Aircall MCP support as 'This community server'.
Self-serve paid signup yields dashboard API keys immediately; docs are public and complete.
API access requires a paid Aircall subscription (3-license minimum, ~$90/mo floor); no free tier.

notes: Re-verified auth (Basic + partner-gated OAuth) on live developer docs, paid-plan API bundling on the official pricing page, and filled the draft's missing MCP evidence: Pipedream's hosted Aircall MCP server (mcp.pipedream.com/app/aircall) for the platform claim and the explicitly-unofficial themobilefirstco/CassiaResearch community servers. Confirmed no Aircall vendor MCP exists. Caveat worth noting: direct Messaging API access is Professional-plan-only.
